mapper.insert: insert into appuser (app_user_id, email, password, mbti_type_id, CREATED_AT, UFILE, MOBILE, NICKNAME, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID) values ( appuser_seq.nextval, #{email}, #{password}, #{mbtiTypeId}, sysdate, #{ufile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mobile}, #{nickname}, #{provider}, #{providerId})
mapper.select: select count(*) from appuser where email = #{email}
mapper.update: update appuser set password= #{password}, mbti_type_id= #{mbtiTypeId}, ufile= #{ufile, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, nickname= #{nickname}, mobile= #{mobile}, provider= #{provider}, provider_id= #{providerId} where email = #{email}
mapper.insert: insert into authorities (AUTH_ID, EMAIL, AUTH) values (authorities_seq.nextval, #{email}, #{auth})
